box: wheel.astro delayed shrink (SPIN_MS=1200) sits above a live ad slot — is this a deliberate-tap CLS-misclick risk? Unticketed; recorded per docs/verification/evidence/adslot/README.md, not tied to a GitHub issue.
method: npm run build; npx serve dist/ -l 4321; headless Chrome via CDP on :9222 with no reduced-motion flag (default motion). node scripts/driver.mjs scripts/adslot-wheel-delay-probe.mjs, REPEAT=5, PROBE_WIDTH=320 (this site's reference viewport). Each run: seeds a roster of 4 long Thai names (forces one name per row at 320px), starts a round on /tool/wheel/, ticks 'เอาคนที่ออกแล้วออกจากวงล้อ', arms a MutationObserver keyed on the FIRST '.is-out' row appearing (the reveal-time render(), not the spin-start render() which also mutates #wheel-names synchronously at tap), records performance.now() at the real touch (Input.dispatchTouchEvent via session.tap — proves the click handler actually fires, not just that the element sits at that point) and at that mutation, samples getBoundingClientRect() for .ad-slot / .wheel-next a / #wheel-reset every animation frame for 2200ms after the tap, then grid-scans (per docs/agents/browser-verification.md trap #2 — never a centre-line sample) each target's PRE-TAP box against every OTHER target's rect across the whole sampled timeline to find any tappable-target collision and how long it would persist. window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches is read from the live page each run, not assumed from the launch flag.

adSlotShiftPx.note: sign convention: positive = ad slot rose (moved toward top of viewport, the hazard direction); negative = ad slot moved further down the page

verdictNote: FAILED against the hypothesized hazard, not against the measurement. The delay is real (~1202-1203ms, matches SPIN_MS=1200) and the ad slot's position does move on ~4/5 runs (-24px), but the direction is DOWN the page (content grows: 'ออกแล้ว' text wraps a long name onto a second line — wheel.astro's render() never removes a row, it only decorates an existing one with is-out/text, contrary to the 'shrink' framing in the brief and the prior README note). A downward shift moves the ad slot AWAY from the targets tested above it (#wheel-reset, the first GameNav link), not into them, so no tappable-target collision was observed in any of the 5 runs, at 320px, for this control/target pair.
scopeNotCovered: Only #wheel-reset and the first GameNav link (.wheel-next a) were tested as candidate 'different tappable target' collision targets, only at 320px, only with a single spin (not a multi-spin sequence), and only with the fixed 4-name LONG_NAMES roster. A different roster length/order or a second/third spin was not walked.
